name: innovate-or-die
description: Generate, attack, revise, and reality-test non-obvious solutions to difficult problems.

interface.shortDescription: Find bold ideas that survive reality checks
interface.longDescription: A staged innovation workflow that generates unconventional hypotheses, attacks them independently, revises the survivors, and converts the strongest ideas into reality-grounded tests.
defaultPrompt: Find a non-obvious solution to this problem.
Challenge the assumptions behind this strategy.
Turn this idea into falsifiable experiments.
